command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: create backing file for PV ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/lvm-backing
sudo -n truncate -s 3G /var/lib/lvm-backing/data.img
ls -lh /var/lib/lvm-backing/data.img

echo "=== STEP 2: attach loop device ==="
sudo -n losetup -f /var/lib/lvm-backing/data.img
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -j /var/lib/lvm-backing/data.img | cut -d: -f1)
echo "LOOPDEV=$LOOPDEV"
echo "$LOOPDEV" | sudo -n tee /var/lib/lvm-backing/loopdev.txt

echo "=== STEP 3: create PV/VG/LV ==="
sudo -n pvcreate -ff -y "$LOOPDEV"
sudo -n vgcreate datavg "$LOOPDEV"
sudo -n lvcreate -L 1G -n datalv datavg
sudo -n lvs datavg

echo "=== STEP 4: format and mount ==="
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f /dev/datavg/datalv
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
sudo -n mount /dev/datavg/datalv /srv/data
df -h /srv/data

echo "=== STEP 5: write test content ==="
sudo -n sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 50); do dd if=/dev/urandom of=/srv/data/testfile_$i.bin bs=1M count=1 status=none; done'
sudo -n sh -c 'sha256sum /srv/data/testfile_*.bin > /srv/data/CHECKSUMS.sha256'
sudo -n du -sh /srv/data
sudo -n sha256sum -c /srv/data/CHECKSUMS.sha256 | tail -5

echo "=== STEP 6: grow LV to >=2G while mounted ==="
sudo -n lvextend -L 2.5G /dev/datavg/datalv
sudo -n xfs_growfs /srv/data
df -h /srv/data
sudo -n lvs datavg

echo "=== STEP 7: verify data intact after grow ==="
sudo -n sha256sum -c /srv/data/CHECKSUMS.sha256 | tail -5
mount | grep /srv/data

echo "=== STEP 8: persist across reboot (loop attach service + fstab) ==="
cat <<'EOF' | sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/datavg-loop.service
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop device backing datavg PV
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=local-fs-pre.target
After=systemd-udevd.service
Conflicts=umount.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup /dev/loop0 /var/lib/lvm-backing/data.img
ExecStop=/sbin/losetup -d /dev/loop0

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
EOF
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable datavg-loop.service

grep -q '/srv/data' /etc/fstab || echo "/dev/datavg/datalv /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=datavg-loop.service 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab | grep srv

echo "=== DONE ==="
